description: The same features written with authenticated encryption as VC124's fix recommends: Node aes-256-gcm, PyCryptodome AES.new(key, AES.MODE_GCM), the cryptography package's AESGCM, Go aes.NewCipher + cipher.NewGCM, Java AES/GCM/NoPadding, Web Crypto AES-GCM in the React vault page, Ruby OpenSSL::Cipher::AES.new(256, :GCM) / OpenSSL::Cipher.new("aes-256-gcm"), and PHP openssl_encrypt with 'aes-256-gcm'. AES.new, aes.NewCipher and new SecretKeySpec(key, "AES") are used by every AES mode, so none may be reported as ECB on its own.
